question: How much will Nasdaq-100 Futures total price returns exceed S&P 500 Futures in these biweekly periods of Q4 2026? (Nov 9 - Nov 20)

calls.reasoning: Reference class: 10-trading-day NQ minus ES return differences. These are centred near 0 to +0.1pp, with an SD of about 1pp in calm regimes and 1.5-2pp in tech-stress regimes. The current regime is stressed: NDX is in its third correction of 2026, Nasdaq fell 5.3% in October, VIX is about 19-24, and capex worries are driving rotation from tech into value. Nvidia earnings fall inside the window (Nov 17 after the close), adding idiosyncratic tech variance. A rebound after the correction would favour NQ because of its higher beta, while the rotation's momentum favours ES, so the median is about +0.05. No human market prices this: the harness found none on Polymarket or Manifold; I did not check Kalshi or bookmakers. I could not pull Yahoo data directly, so dispersion comes from news-reported daily moves.
